property_summary: If Initialized() has been called, subsequent calls to SetMinSum do not change MinSum (i.e. MinSum remains equal to the value read after initialization).
After calling Initialized(), SetMinSum always reverts (so reverted == true whenever Initialized() was called before it).
After calling SetMinSum(x) before Initialized(), the public MinSum getter returns exactly x.
After calling SetMinSum(x) before Initialized(), the stored MinSum equals the provided x (i.e., MinSum == x).

After initializing MinSum via SetMinSum with any nonzero _val and then calling Initialized(), Acc balances remain withdrawable only if they meet the set minimum (i.e., Collect succeeds only when Acc.balance >= the previously set MinSum).

property_summary: After calling SetMinSum(x) (before Initialized), reading MinSum returns the same value x that was passed in.
Calling SetMinSum succeeds (does not revert) and results in c.MinSum() equaling the provided input.
Calls to SetMinSum(...) never revert (always succeed) for any input when made on the original contract
SetMinSum can be successfully called before Initialized() (does not revert) and sets MinSum accordingly.
SetMinSum is callable (does not revert) exactly when the contract has not been initialized yet (i.e., Initialized() has not been called).

After setting MinSum to any value and initializing, collecting with amount equal to that MinSum from an account with exactly that balance and unlock passed must succeed (i.e., reduce contract balance), which fails if MinSum cannot be set to zero.
After depositing and then calling Collect for the same amount, the contract's balance must decrease (finalBal < afterPut).
After depositing and then calling Collect for the same amount, the contract's balance must decrease (finalBal < afterPut).
After depositing then calling Collect for the same amount, the contract's balance must decrease (finalBal < afterPut).
After calling Collect, the contract's balance must be strictly less than it was immediately after Put (finalBal < afterPut).

After any sequence where a caller funds the contract and then calls Collect, the global MinSum remains unchanged (still zero) in the reference contract for all inputs; the mutant that requires MinSum != 0 in SetMinSum can cause MinSum to become nonzero before Collect and thus lead to a differing MinSum value observed after Collect for some inputs.
